findings.question: Tax (Tax assessments, returns and payment history for persons and companies): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: La direction générale des finances publiques est autorisée à mettre en œuvre un traitement automatisé d'informations nominatives sous l'appellation ILIAD (informatisation de l'inspection d'assiette et de documentation).
findings.quote_english: The Directorate-General of Public Finances is authorised to operate an automated processing of personal information under the name ILIAD (computerisation of the assessment and documentation inspection).
findings.value: ILIAD (informatisation de l'inspection d'assiette et de documentation) (computerisation of the tax assessment and documentation inspection)
findings.title: Arrêté du 25 juillet 1988 autorisant la création d'un traitement automatisé relatif à l'informatisation des inspections d'assiette et de documentation
findings.note: Article 1 of the consolidated arrêté, last updated 2017-07-05. Article 2 says ILIAD manages income tax, housing tax, CSG and CRDS. A Cour des comptes report from 2019 is said to expect ILIAD to become obsolete around 2025, but I could not fetch it (connection refused), so this is unverified. Légifrance may block machine fetches.

review.established: ILIAD (informatisation de l'inspection d'assiette et de documentation)
review.reason: Under the decree of 25 July 1988, the DGFiP runs a processing named ILIAD, whose purpose is managing the taxpayer's tax file, so the quote gives the system's name.
